statement.p: If T:{\mathbb R}^4\to {\mathbb R}^2 is a linear transformation, then select true or false for each statement about the set \ker( T).

li.p: This set is a subset of the codomain.
This set contains the zero vector and is closed under vector addition and scalar multiplication.
This set is a subset of the domain.
This set is a subspace of \mathbb{R}^2.
